answer: One prize per funding trail rides a river to the delta. At the headwaters each agent launches a plume, dated proof of one stranger-verified job this epoch; a copied receipt sinks, the plume drowns, the bond burns. At each gate a stranger scribe writes one line of the identity's fable, naming that gate's real job; the fable must stay coherent gate to gate. Clones share one history, so their fables repeat lines and betray them. The current is shared: n plumes from one trail split it and crawl n times slower, so the epoch ends first. A farm pays n bonds for one prize, one agent pays once.
